body:
After two sessions of trying to reproduce this bug, it had seemingly stopped to appear. This might have been an issue with the AMD GPU Driver, because i've updated my system packages recently.

Closing this issue now.

I'm having what appears to be the same issue.
The issue is somewhat reproducible. Sometimes running the project is fine, sometimes it causes a crash.
In my case, it happens almost immediately after starting the project (as opposed to a few minutes).

Linux v7.1.3

```
Godot v4.7.stable.mono (5b4e0cb0f) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:26.05 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat Jul  4 13:34:22 UTC 2026 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600KF (16 threads) - 31.17 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)
```
